gloss: I don't know though; just saying

definitions.gloss: I don't know though; just saying; but don't quote me on that
definitions.explanation: A casual expression used as a hedge after making a statement, often from Kansai dialect.

examples.japanese: あの{店|みせ}、おいしいらしいよ。{知|し}らんけど。
examples.english: Apparently that restaurant is good. I don't know though.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}は{晴|は}れるって。{知|し}らんけど。
examples.english: They say it'll be sunny tomorrow. Just saying.

examples.japanese: あの{二人|ふたり}、{付|つ}き{合|あ}ってるらしい。{知|し}らんけど。
examples.english: I heard those two are dating. But don't quote me on that.

notes:
Originally from Kansai dialect, this phrase has spread nationwide through social media and TV.

USAGE:
Added at the end of a statement to disclaim responsibility for accuracy. The speaker shares information but signals they cannot guarantee it.

NUANCE:
・Softens assertions and avoids sounding too definitive
・Often used when sharing rumors or hearsay
・Can be humorous or ironic
・Popular internet/youth slang

VARIATIONS:
・{知|し}らんけど (Kansai-origin)
・{知|し}らないけど (standard Japanese)
・{分|わ}からんけど (alternative)
